meta.title: Fieldwise — ulwazi lwezolimo
meta.description: Isiqondiso esilula sezitshalo, amasimu nesimo sezulu sabalimi.

dashboard.networkIntro: Inethiwekhi yokufunda eyabelana ngedatha yezolimo ephethwe endaweni.
dashboard.climateIntro: Hlela amanzi ngokwesimo sezulu nesitshalo sendawo.

weather.holdIrrigation: cabangela ukunisela kuze kube ngemva kweshawa.

alerts.heavyRain: Kulindeleke imvula enkulu eKhanna ngoLwesine. Hlehlisa ukunisela.
alerts.lowMoisture: Umswakama womhlabathi uphansi ensimini yesoya eRiver Bend. Hlola insimu namuhla.
alerts.leafSpot: Isithombe sakho sakamuva singase sibonise amabala emaqabungeni. Buyekeza ukuhlolwa.
alerts.weeklyReport: Umbiko wakho wamasonto onke wezempilo yepulazi usulungile.
alerts.diagnosisRisk: I-{{disease}} itholwe ngokuzethemba okukhulu. Buyekeza isiqondiso sokwelashwa.

speech.greeting: Sawubona, {{name}}. Namuhla umhla ka-{{date}}. Lalela okwenzekayo epulazini lakho.
speech.weather: Namuhla izinga lokushisa lingu-{{temperature}} degrees, kanti isimo sezulu {{condition}}.
speech.rain: Kulindeleke imvula engaba amamilimitha angu-{{amount}} ngo-{{day}}. Ungalinda kuze kudlule imvula ngaphambi kokunisela.
speech.healthy: Izindaba ezinhle. {{fieldName}} iphilile futhi inhlabathi inamanzi anele. Kutshalwe {{crops}}.
speech.summary: Unezinkambu ezisebenzayo ezingu-{{count}}. Isilinganiso sempilo yepulazi singu-{{score}} ekhulwini. Wonge amanzi angamaphesenti angu-{{saved}}.
speech.diagnosisPrompt: Khetha isitshalo bese wengeza isithombe esicacile seqabunga.
speech.climateIntro: Namuhla izinga lokushisa lingu-{{temperature}} degrees, kanti isimo sezulu {{condition}}. {{rain}} {{plan}}
speech.networkIntro: I-Fieldwise isiza ukwabelana ngolwazi lwezolimo kuyilapho igcina imininingwane yasemapulazini iphephile.
speech.ending: Yilokho okwamanje. Cindezela inkinobho futhi ukuze ulalele futhi.
speech.unavailable: Izwi lalolu limi alitholakali kule divayisi. Ngizozama elinye izwi.
speech.communityIntro: Siyakwamukela emphakathini weFieldwise. Kunezibuyekezo zabalimi ezingu-{{postCount}}. Lalela ezimbalwa zakamuva.
speech.communityEnding: Yabelana ngezindaba zensimu yakho noma uxhumane nomunye umlimi.
speech.planAfterRain: linda kuze kudlule imvula yangoLwesine bese uhlola inhlabathi yaseNorth Field
speech.leafReminder: Isoya yaseRiver Bend ingaba namabala emaqabungeni. Buyekeza ukuhlolwa kwesithombe.
speech.waterReminder: Nisela iNorth Field kusasa. Hlola inhlabathi kuqala ngoba iya koma.
speech.diagnosisAdvice: Susa amaqabunga alimele kakhulu futhi ungacheleli emaqabungeni. Hlola futhi ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu noma ezine.
speech.playbackError: Ukudlalwa kwezwi akukwazanga ukuqhubeka. Sicela uzame futhi.

community.title: Ngisebenzele izinkampani ezintathu
community.subtitle: Funda futhi ukhule nabalimi abanjengawe
community.noFarmers: Abekho abalimi abafanelana nalezi zilimo okwamanje.

community.emptyCopy: Khetha esinye isivuno noma wabelane ngezilungiso nomphakathi wakini.

settings.autoReadDescription: Dlala i-chime emfushane bese ufunda imiyalezo emisha ebucayi ngokuzwakalayo.

fields.addIntro: Qala ukulandelela impilo yezitshalo nezimo zendawo.
fields.noMatchesAdd: Akukho okufanayo. Cindezela u-Enter ukuze ufake
fields.sampleObservations: Isampula lesikhala sokubona liyaboniswa kule MVP.

overview.leafSpotDetected: Kungenzeka kutholakale indawo yeqabunga esithombeni sakho sakamuva.
overview.moistureLowWeather: Umswakama wenhlabathi uphansi ngaphambi kwesimo sezulu esifudumele.
overview.privacyTitle: Yakhelwe izwe lakho, noma ngabe likuphi.
overview.privacyCopy: Imibono yendawo ivumelane nesifunda sakho nezindlela zokukhula zendawo.

vegetation.title: Impilo yemifino
vegetation.chartAlt: Impilo yemifino ikhuphuke kancane kancane emasontweni amahlanu edlule

climate.waitAfterRain: Linda kuze kube ngemva kwemvula yangoLwesine
climate.guidance: Isiqondiso sesampula: hlola umswakama wenhlabathi futhi ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni ngaphambi kokunisela i-North Field.
climate.sampleNotice: Amanani okubikezela nokunisela ayisampula ledatha. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wesimo sezulu wendawo ukuze uthole iseluleko esibukhoma.

diagnostics.intro: Thatha isithombe esicacile seqabunga elithintekile. Sizohlola izimpawu ezivamile zempilo yezitshalo bese sisikisela ukuthi yini okufanele siyenze ngokulandelayo.
diagnostics.tipCallout: Ezinye izimpawu zibukeka zifana. Ubungcweti bendawo bukusiza ukhethe isinyathelo esifanele esilandelayo.
diagnostics.apiEnglishFallback: I-API ibuyise imininingwane yesiNgisi ngoba imininingwane ye-{{language}} yasendaweni yayingatholakali.
diagnostics.apiLanguagesAvailable: I-API isekela isiNgisi, isiHindi, isiPutukezi nesiShayina.
diagnostics.orBrowse: noma bhrawuza amafayela kusuka kudivayisi yakho
diagnostics.fileLimit: I-JPG noma i-PNG · kuze kufike ku-10 MB · Ikhamera isekelwa
diagnostics.uncertainTitle: Asiqiniseki. Zama isithombe esicace kakhudlwana seqabunga elithintekile.
diagnostics.uncertainCopy: Qiniseka ukuthi iqabunga ligxile futhi ligcwalisa ingxenye enkulu yefreyimu.
diagnostics.noTreatment: Ayikho imininingwane yokwelashwa ebuyiselwe kulo mphumela.
diagnostics.chooseFieldToSave: Khetha isikhala ukuze ugcine lokhu kuxilongwa
diagnostics.disclaimer: Lo mphumela ungowesiqondiso. Qinisekisa ukuxilongwa nesazi sezolimo sendawo ngaphambi kokwelashwa.

errors.badImage: Isithombe asikwazanga ukuphroseswa. Hlola ukuthi yi-JPG noma i-PNG ecacile, bese uzama futhi.
errors.unauthorized: Ukungena empilweni yezitshalo kwenqatshiwe. Sicela uhlole ukumiswa kwesevisi.
errors.notFound: Indawo yokuphela yesevisi ayitholakali. Hlola ukumiswa kweseva bese uqala kabusha iseva ye-Dev.
errors.rateLimit: Isevisi yesivuno.impilo ayinawo amakhredithi atholakalayo noma isilinganiso esilinganiselwe. Zama futhi kamuva noma usebenzise umphumela wedemo.
errors.service: Isevisi yesivuno.impilo inenkinga. Sicela uzame futhi maduzane noma usebenzise umphumela wedemo.
errors.unexpected: Isevisi yezempilo yesivuno ibuyise iphutha elingalindelekile. Sicela uzame futhi noma usebenzise umphumela wedemo.
errors.unreadable: Isevisi yezempilo yesivuno ibuyise impendulo engafundeki. Sicela uzame futhi noma usebenzise umphumela wedemo.
errors.timeout: Ukuhlolwa kwezithombe kwathatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. Sicela uzame futhi ngesithombe esincane noma esicace kakhudlwana.
errors.connection: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela ku crop.health. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
errors.failed: Ukuhlolwa kwezithombe kwehlulekile. Sicela uzame futhi.
errors.imageTooLarge: Lesi sithombe sikhulu kuno-10 MB. Khetha isithombe esincane.

network.heroCopy: I-Fieldwise iklanyelwe ukuvumela izifunda ezibambe iqhaza zithuthukise amamodeli ezolimo ndawonye kuyilapho kugcinwa idatha engahluziwe epulazini ngaphakathi kwemingcele
network.exampleStatus: Isibonelo sesimo sokuthunyelwa. Akukho ukuqeqeshwa komfelandawonye okubukhoma okuxhunyiwe kule MVP.
network.sovereigntyCopy: Ohlelweni lokukhiqiza, izibuyekezo zemodeli ezibuyekeziwe kuphela ezingashiya indawo yesifunda. Amarekhodi omlimi ahlala esendaweni.

auth.loginIntro: Ngena ngemvume ukuze ubone ukuthi kwenzekani epulazini lakho.
auth.signupIntro: Sungula i-akhawunti yakho yabalimi ukuze uqalise.
auth.privacyNote: Imininingwane yakho yasepulazini ihlala ilawulwa nguwe.
auth.invalidCredentials: Igama lomsebenzisi noma iphasiwedi engalungile. Sicela uphinde uthayiphe bese uzama futhi.
auth.sessionSaveError: Ayikwazi ukugcina iseshini yedemo kule bhrawuza.
auth.passwordShort: Iphasiwedi kufanele okungenani ibe nezinhlamvu ezingu-8.
auth.accountSaveError: Ayikwazi ukugcina i-akhawunti yedemo kule bhrawuza.
